fact: At the first Ministry Council meeting on 7 August 2025 the Minister of Communications and Digital Transformation directed that expert firms be commissioned to review the ministry's existing policies; no successor policy is announced.
title: مجلس وزير التحول الرقمي و الاتصالات يضع أسس التحول الرقمي وإعادة الإعمار عبر التقنية
